description: Create the tracker issue AND start the run in one call, for work that has no issue yet. Pass entryStartAt='builder' with an entryPlan to hand over a plan you already wrote; pass entryStartAt='reviewer'/'qa' with entryPrNumber to hand over an existing build — in which case title may be omitted and the pull request's own title names the mission. For the first mission of a SHIP Sites project, pass starter (website, blog, docs or waitlist) and site, the shared form, in place of title and description: SHIP writes the issue, or a mission with no issue on a project SHIP made with Start from scratch, and holds the site address. Read list_site_starters first. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the missions:run token scope.

agents.description: Per-role harness/model override for THIS mission only; overrides ship.yml without changing it

description.description: Issue body; acceptance criteria written here are parsed as they would be on any issue

entryPrNumber.description: Existing open PR number, required for entryStartAt='reviewer' or 'qa'

entryStartAt.description: Pipeline stage to enter at; omit for the default full run starting at the planner

projectId.description: Project id the mission belongs to

site.description: The form of a site starter. Required with starter; leave out title, description, labels and entry

audience.description: website and waitlist: the main audience

author.description: blog: the author of the first post

brand.description: Where the brand comes from (one of three sources)

brandName.description: 2 to 60 characters, for the sources logo and preset

logo.description: The logo file, for the brand source logo

data.description: The file, base64-encoded, up to 2 MB

presetId.description: A preset id from list_brand_presets, for the source preset

source.description: website: SHIP captures the brand from websiteUrl. logo: from logo. preset: one of list_brand_presets

websiteUrl.description: An https URL that answers, for the source website

brandRights.description: The confirmation of the person the token acts for: they own this brand or have the right to use it. Send it only when that person confirmed the text that list_site_starters gives.

offerings.description: website: one to three products or services

outline.description: docs: three to seven page titles

product.description: waitlist: what people join the waitlist for. Only a project SHIP made with Start from scratch takes it

productWebsite.description: docs: the product website, an https URL

slug.description: The site address: https://<slug>.letsship.app, 3 to 40 of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens

topic.description: blog: the topic of the first post

starter.description: The first mission of a SHIP Sites project of this kind; needs site

title.description: Issue title. Omit ONLY with entryPrNumber — the pull request's own title is then used

name: create_mission
title: Create a mission
